run_f_gold: run f_gold to count elements whose value equals their frequency in a subarray range
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameter sets to validate transcoder correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts array elements where value matches frequency in a given range
